verified_source_facts: Aglib singleExtOneClass is ProjectiveResolution.extMk of the unnegated toSpanSingleton cocycle in degree one.
Aglib singleIdealExtOneClass precomposes that class with the inverse scalar-quotient-to-ideal-quotient isomorphism.
Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extMk_hom represents extMk by the unnegated Cocycle.toSingleMk shifted morphism after inverting the augmentation.
Mathlib mappingCone.triangle defines its third arrow using -mappingCone.fst. The public inl_v_triangle_mor₃_f identity explicitly includes that minus sign.
Mathlib ShortExact.extClass_hom identifies the extension class with singleδ, which uses the same cone triangle third arrow.
Mathlib Cochain.δ_toSingleMk has sign n-prime.negOnePow. For a degree-zero cochain beta and degree-one differential this contributes a minus.

implemented_interface.statement: For h : delta beta + alpha.comp(ofHom phi) = 0, lift phi alpha beta h followed by triangle(phi).mor3 equals equivHomShift.symm(-alpha).
implemented_interface.scope: Any preadditive category with binary biproducts; no abelian, module, finiteness or resolution assumptions.
implemented_interface.provenance: New supporting identity directly deduced from pinned Mathlib definitions and lift projection API; not claimed to be an original Aglib declaration.
